name: PTG Energy Public Company Limited
summary: PTG Energy Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, trades in petroleum products, gas products, and supplies and equipment for oil service station, consumable products, transportation, e-money services, and renewable energy and investment business in Thailand. It operates through Sales of Petroleum products; Gas Products, and Supplies and Equipment for Oil Service Stations; Sales of Consumable Products; and Transportation business segment.
